scenes.text: Corruption Perceptions Index 2025. Brazil: 35 points. Rank 107 of 182. Second-worst score in the series.
Global average: 42. The country sits well below it. The agency that regulates the skies receives a governance trophy in the same season.
Numbers do not prove any single case. They do make the silence louder.
